pages.title: Toxodon
pages.text: The Toxodon ($(o)Toxodon platensis$()) is an extinct notoungulate that lived in South America during the Pleistocene, disappearing at its end.$(br2)It was a heavy, rhinoceros-sized herbivore with short legs and a broad head. Its name, meaning "bow tooth", refers to its curved, ever-growing teeth.$(br2)The first Toxodon skull known to science was obtained by Charles Darwin in Uruguay during the voyage of the Beagle.
